blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Unity Party (NUP) on Wednesday called for an end to withholding district funding as political punishment for lawmakers who break ranks and do not toe the line, saying the practice is a form of retribution that ultimately harms their constituencies. “The practice of punishing districts and communities for any opinions or votes contrary to majority positions that are expressed by their representatives should be ended,” Deputy Speaker Ronaldo Puno told a media briefing. “We are, after all, a democracy.” “We’re supposed to be speaking out.
